name: Rancor, Ancient

behaviors.name: Siege Monster
behaviors.description: The Rancor deals double damage to objects and structures.

behaviors.name: Legendary Resistance
behaviors.description: If the Rancor fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

behaviors.name: Multiattack
behaviors.description: The Rancor can use its Frightful Roar. It then makes three attacks: two with its claws, and one with its bite. It can use its swallow instead of its bite.

behaviors.name: Claw
behaviors.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 20 (3d8 + 7) Kinetic damage.

behaviors.name: Bite

behaviors.name: Throw Boulder
behaviors.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 60/240 ft., one target. Hit 33 (4d12 + 7) Kinetic damage.

behaviors.name: Frightful Roar
behaviors.description: Each creature of the rancor's choice within 90 feet of it must succeed a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if the Rancor is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the rancor's Frightful Roar for the next 24 hours.

behaviors.name: Swallow
behaviors.description: hits, the target takes the bite's damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the Rancor, and it takes 35 (10d6) acid damage at the start of each of the Rancor's turns. If the Rancor takes 35 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the Rancor must suceed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the Rancor. If the Rancor dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone. behaviors.description: The Rancor makes one claw attack.

behaviors.name: Throw
behaviors.description: The Rancor uses its throw boulder

behaviors.name: Chomp
behaviors.description: The Rancor makes one bite attack or uses its swallow.

sectionText: Rancors are large carnivorous reptomammals native to the planet of Dathomir. They are commonly kept as pets by affluent, less-than-reputable types.
